club_orientation_scope: Separate triads provide possible future orientation observations. Algebraic orthogonality is not physical rigidity; changing head/grip relative orientation is not attributed to an identified cause. Fixture alignment and exact native-body assignment remain unqualified.
club_orientation_window_initial_probe_sc: Stops before fitting because probe incorrectly assumes a unique World Frame. Separate corrected probe matches authoritative IK frame-selection policy and records selected native frame privately; no pose result is claimed from this failed run.
club_orientation_window_second_probe_sco: Stops before fitting on the same unsupported uniqueness assumption for Clubhead blocks. Subsequent probe uses both authoritative IK frame selectors and records paths privately; neither failed attempt produced a fit.
club_position_target_scope: Authoritative fourteen-position-target objective includes club_head only. club_grip is derived by capture processing but omitted from the IK target list. Clubhead native /R position and body rotation support its calibrated offset; no two-centroid fit claim.
